title: Laundry & Major Appliances Quarter-over-Quarter Volume Shift
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:washer
| bin _time span=1q
| stats count as events by _time
| streamstats current=f last(events) as prev_q by _time
| eval qoq_pct=round(100*(events-prev_q)/prev_q,1)
| where isnotnull(prev_q) AND prev_q>0
| sort - _time
description: Compares event volume quarter over quarter for laundry telemetry in index=personal.
value: Seasonal life domains swing a lot; a quarter view separates real habit change from normal summer/winter noise without overreacting to one bad week.
implementation: Keep `thinq:washer` events flowing into `index=personal` with stable timestamps, then review QoQ percent change during quarterly personal ops reviews.
visualization: Column chart of events by quarter with QoQ percent labels.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how much your laundry activity changed compared with last quarter so you can tell a real shift from normal seasonal ups and downs.
